# fptcloud_database_backup (Data Source)

Retrieves the backup service of a FPT Cloud database cluster: its state, capacity, usage and backup jobs.

## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The Id of the database cluster.

### Read-Only

- `backup_service_id` (Number) The Id of the backup service. Null when backup is not enabled.
- `capacity_gb` (Number) Backup capacity in GB.
- `id` (String) The Id of the database cluster.
- `jobs` (List of Object) Backup jobs of the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jobs))
- `retention_type` (String) How retention is counted, `quantity` or `day`.
- `status` (String) State of the backup service: inactive, enabled, processing, deleting, updating, active, deactivating, error_enabled, error_deleted or error_updated.
- `used_gb` (Number) Used part of the backup capacity in GB.

<a id="nestedatt--jobs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jobs`

Read-Only:

- `days_of_week` (Set of Number)
- `hours` (Set of Number)
- `is_run_now` (Boolean)
- `job_id` (Number)
- `minute` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `retention` (Number)
- `status` (String)
- `type` (String) `full` or `diff`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fptcloud_database_backup" "db" {
  cluster_id = "owiiqtii"
}

output "backup_status" {
  value = data.fptcloud_database_backup.db.status
}
```
